verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents built-in event-driven automation in specific domains. Conditional access instantly revokes access when a user leaves a trusted network or a device falls out of compliance, and HRIS integration provides automatic onboarding and offboarding workflows. There is no evidence of a general-purpose, user-definable rules engine that maps arbitrary events to arbitrary actions. The API and PowerShell bulk operations are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-defined event→action rule builder, configurable triggers beyond compliance/network/HR lifecycle, a documented catalog of actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
